qualifications.composition: Nominal oxide recipes define these source-qualified identities, not certified final stoichiometry. Table 1 ICP-OES results remain distinct from nominal values; the authors discuss possible incomplete dissolution/silica underrepresentation, boron/silicon disagreement and sodium loss during melting. No assay correction, recipe normalization or exact final purity is inferred.
qualifications.sample_count: The density method uses at least five pieces, each 0.1-1.0 g. Exact piece count, independent preparation-batch count and readings per piece are not reported. These pieces are not asserted to be five independent experimental replicates.
qualifications.property_scope: Catalog-only furnace-cooled experimental mass-density reference. Quenched states and all mechanical, spectroscopic and computed values are excluded. Density-test temperature, pressure and conditioning are unknown; room temperature and about 33% RH in the nanoindentation method are not transferred. Archimedes measurement does not establish a true/bulk/apparent density classification or zero porosity.

four_percent_exception.text: Melt too viscous to pour; transferred together with its crucible into a preheated furnace, cooled to room temperature, then drilled out of the crucible.
